title: Gym-Anything for Robotics: Scaling physical simulations with digital agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.40565v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Realistic, fast robotics simulations could enable large-scale training of embodied AI models that transfer to the real world. However, despite decades of progress, available simulations cover only a narrow range of real-world tasks and physical phenomena. The core bottleneck is that creating better simulations requires significant expert effort and therefore does not scale. To address this, we introduce Gym-Anything for Robotics, a framework in which coding agents create realistic robotics simulations. Our core insight is that simulation creation is a coding agent task, so improvements in coding agents translate directly into richer and more faithful simulations. We select simulations based on U.S. GDP data to cover economically valuable physical work, define what makes a good simulation and a good task, and develop an adversarial creation-audit loop that checks each simulation and task against these definitions. translated_title: Gym-Anything for Robotics：利用数字智能体扩展物理仿真
translated_abstract: 逼真且快速的机器人仿真有望实现具身AI模型的大规模训练，并使其能力迁移到真实世界。然而，尽管经过数十年的发展，现有仿真仅覆盖了狭窄范围的真实世界任务和物理现象。其核心瓶颈在于，创建更好的仿真需要大量专家投入，因而难以规模化。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Gym-Anything for Robotics，一个由代码编写智能体（coding agents）创建逼真机器人仿真的框架。我们的核心洞察是：仿真创建本质上是一项代码智能体任务，因此代码智能体能力的提升可以直接转化为更丰富、更逼真的仿真。我们基于美国GDP数据来选择仿真内容，以覆盖具有经济价值的体力工作；定义了什么是好的仿真和好的任务；并开发了一个对抗性的创建-审计循环，依据这些定义对每个仿真和任务进行检查。利用这一流程，我们……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Gym-Anything for Robotics框架，通过让代码编写智能体自动创建机器人仿真，并采用基于GDP数据的任务筛选与对抗性创建-审计循环，实现了物理仿真的规模化自动生成。
en_tdlr: Gym-Anything for Robotics is a framework in which coding agents automatically create realistic robotics simulations, scaling physical simulation generation through GDP-based task selection and an adversarial creation-audit loop.
